subtitles.en: Supply clean water to the basin.

subtitles.zh: 围合公共厕所：示例内部14×4＝56格，手压泵留在房间外，出口经过洗手盆。
subtitles.en: Enclose a 14 x 4 interior: 56 cells. Keep the pitcher pump outside and route the exit past the wash basin.

subtitles.zh: 观察同一复制人如厕后经过洗手盆；示意画面不能替代真实试运行。
subtitles.en: Observe the same duplicant using the toilet and then washing. The illustration does not replace an actual trial.

subtitles.zh: 核对真实运行与资源供应；短片为示意，任务以存档检查或知识确认为准。
subtitles.en: Verify real operation and supplies. This is an illustration; completion uses colony checks or learning confirmation.
